summary: save a URL as a wiki note (type: bookmark); best-effort title fetch; --archive snapshots to ~/files
hints: Save a URL as a wiki bookmark note (title fetched best-effort). Body text is extracted via trafilatura when installed (optional dep; pip install trafilatura), else a crude zero-dependency tag-strip. --archive additionally snapshots the fetched page HTML into ~/files/bookmarks/ against link-rot (skipped if the page wasn't reachable). Any http(s) URL is accepted as a generic link/article — a tweet or video URL is saved the same way, there is no special x.com/YouTube parsing (see `plainkeep files extract` for transcript extraction of an already-ingested media file). Common mistake: --archive without a reachable page — the HTML snapshot is skipped.
